quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: Local hours during which only a blocker may reach the owner.

weekly_deliveries.title: Deliveries per week
weekly_deliveries.description: How many times the executive layer may interrupt in a rolling 7 days. A blocker does not count.

dedup_window_hours.title: Repeat window
dedup_window_hours.description: How far back an identical finding still counts as already said.

ledger_path.title: Decision ledger
ledger_path.description: Where the company's decisions are kept, relative to the project root. It is the orchestrator's episodic memory.

orchestrator_agent.title: Orchestrator
orchestrator_agent.description: The agent that writes the briefs and is the only one that hands anything to the super-agent.

daily_schedule.title: Daily pulse
daily_schedule.description: Cron for the daily pulse. It has to fall OUTSIDE quiet hours, or the guard holds every single run and the layer looks dead.

biweekly_schedule.title: Decision brief
biweekly_schedule.description: How often the decision brief runs.

deliver_to.title: Where the run is filed
deliver_to.description: The channel the run itself is archived on. NOT how the owner is reached — that is the super-agent's decision, always.
